catalog.sql: SELECT ROUTINETYPE, ORIGIN, LANGUAGE, PARM_COUNT, DETERMINISTIC, SQL_DATA_ACCESS, NULL_CALL, RESULT_SETS, COMMIT_ON_RETURN, VERSION, ACTIVE, DEBUG_MODE, PARAMETER_CCSID FROM SYSIBM.SYSROUTINES WHERE SCHEMA = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}' AND ROUTINETYPE = 'P'
SELECT ORDINAL, PARMNAME, ROWTYPE, TYPENAME, LENGTH, SCALE, CCSID FROM SYSIBM.SYSPARMS WHERE SCHEMA = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}' AND ROUTINETYPE = 'P' AND VERSION = 'V1'
SELECT TYPE, VERSION, APPLCOMPAT FROM SYSIBM.SYSPACKAGE WHERE COLLID = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}'

preflight: SELECT SCHEMA, NAME, SPECIFICNAME FROM SYSIBM.SYSROUTINES WHERE SCHEMA = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND (NAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}' OR SPECIFICNAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}')
SELECT COLLID, NAME, VERSION FROM SYSIBM.SYSPACKAGE WHERE COLLID = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{PROCEDURE}}'
prerequisites: Configure the SQL processor outer terminator as @ and preserve lines/comments; SPUFI SQLFORMAT SQLPL is required for the comment fixtures.
Verify CREATEIN and native package creation authority, and the declared APPLCOMPAT against the actual subsystem. DISABLE DEBUG MODE avoids the debug WLM requirement for this body.
SPECIFIC must equal the procedure name and schema. This model creates one V1 version; overloads and version replacement are outside its scope.

Call probes require a driver/harness that binds marker 1 as IN INTEGER and marker 2 as OUT VARCHAR(64), preserves trailing spaces, and has EXECUTE authority. They are not directly executable SPUFI scripts.
Capture SYSROUTINES.TEXT losslessly. Full CREATE text includes relocated names and is outside the plain catalog equality contract.
